raw_report.method: Per 300×250 cell exact interior fill segmentation (RGB distance ≤3), pixel centers x+0.5/y+0.5, predicted-corner nearest-fill/AA distance, bounds occupied-cell extents, pure pixels outside analytic quadrilateral, full-color interior coverage and black-dot centroid. AA-supported corners explicitly separated from pure-fill matches.
raw_report.limitations: AA color blend is estimated against modal cell background; if edge crosses a guide line, residual can be affected. This quantitative check does not replace actual image inspection. Geometry facts independently computed from input; any artifact mismatch is preserved in output.
